methodology.scope: apps/web source/config plus packages/ui/src; excludes generated folders and test/spec files; includes registry, mock-data, store, JSON and comments. Lexical matches may include samples and data. JSX openings with nested <> or aliased imports need manual review. Reach is conservative static import closure including layouts, not runtime usage; unused exports inflate reach, unresolved package entrypoints/dynamic imports can undercount.
